thought.text: The init script requires `jq` which is missing. Let me install it, then run the initialization.

reasoning_content:
jq is required by init.sh but not installed. Let me check the OS and install jq. After that, I'll run init.sh.

Note: init.sh also requires openssl (already installed). Let me install jq via apt.

action.command: cat /etc/os-release | head -3; apt-get install -y jq 2>&1 | tail -5 || (apt-get update 2>&1 | tail -3 && apt-get install -y jq 2>&1 | tail -5)
